reviews.title: First Time - Good Experience
reviews.text: I rarely fly within countries abroad and usually opt for train travel and I never fly budget airlines. On this particular day I was flying from San Sebastian, Spain to Malaga, Spain. The weather in San Sebastian turned for the worse and it was bad enough for the flights to be diverted to Bilbao. Volotea informed us that since our flight was diverted that they would have to bus us to Bilbao and fly from there. Of course, I was not happy, but this was due to the weather and it was hard to place blame. We waited about 90 minutes for the bus to arrive and then there was communication that Volotea was able to get a plane to come to San Sebastian with the improved weather. We were then processed and were able to board the plane. All in all we were delayed for 2 hours. Once on board, the professionalism of the crew was great. I think many people have become quite demanding of airlines recently, and I think given the circumstances that this was a great experience of this company.

reviews.title: Never flying with Volotea again!
reviews.text: In my Volotea-account it was shown that I could bring 2 pieces of luggage on my flight but when I arrived at the check-in I was only allowed to bring 1 bag. I was then charged 50 euros for the extra bag and the ladies at the check-in told me I could get the money back because it was a mistake from the company and website, not mine. However, after reaching out multiple times over email I finally got a response (about a month or 2 later), saying they wouldn't give me back the money. I am extremely unsatisfied by the customer service from Volotea and will surely not be booking with them again.

reviews.title: Rude Unhelpful & Disgusting Service from your staff!!! Do not fly!!!
reviews.text: Firstly @volotea you need to remove the 2 female members of staff from your team who checked us in or provide them with some serious training on customer service, I know it was 6am and being their age they probably needed a little more sleep but their attitude was disgusting & unessecary to a family with a 2 year olf & 4 year old. You made our experience as a family completelty stressful & it was absolutely unecceasry behaviour. We have been flying regularly since Janurary & all your competitor airlines did not treat us in this same manner. We paid online in advance for 4 x bags x 20KGS as we have with all our other flights on many other airlines this year since Jan. I explained we had a bag damaged so we had placed the contents of our 4 x bags now into 3 x bags. Our 3 x bags weighed 74kgs within the 80kgs we purchased & they refused to check us in. The 2 female staff that were working checkin at Oblia on 21/06/23 gave us no alternate options to overcome the problem other than go open your bags & move things around to make weight. They said we have 3 bags & can only have 3 bags at 20kgs. even though we paid over $400 for 80kgs almost double the actual flight cost!! Its not like were trying to hide baggage here or sneak on with carry on only, we literally paid in advance for the additional weight eithically. We took their advice, went & shifted our bags around & removed items into our carry on luggage. We did this, we came back, & they still would not check us in. the only option was to pay 15 euros per kilo that we were over the 20kilo limit per bag!! & she could not do that at check in, the only option was to go back to the ticket centre & do this. I went to ticket centre they could not help me!! super helpful. Our bags were 24kg, 25kg & 25kg = 74kg the cost to have our bags checked in they wanted 210 euros!!! EVEN THOUGH I WAS 6KGS UNDER THE LIMIT I HAD PAID FOR!! Absolutely disgusting attitiude, very unhelpful & rude staff. I went to speak with the airport supervisor & explained our situation, she took me back to volotea checkin & got us checked in immediately, she even confirmed that the volotea staff are known to be rude & unhelpful. this proves the checkin of our bags was absolutely possible!!! & a solution was within reach for us. your staff simply chose to say no & be rude.
reviews.author: Paul Simpson

reviews.title: Terrible Service, Unreachable, and Website Doesn't Work
reviews.text: I booked a flight from Nantes to Rome on July 21-23. It's been 12 hours since, and I've received no confirmation email. I tried repeatedly to book again, in the hope it would work, but it says there is already an existing booking with the same information. I can't fill out the form to send a new confirmation email, because when I put in Nantes as my origin, Rome does not show up as an option for a destination. I tried to online chat with a representative and the chat repeatedly failed due to an "unknown reason". I also tried sending an email about the situation, but they require you to input a booking number to send the form, which I clearly don't have. Terrible service, their website doesn't work, and I may have just gotten scammed.
reviews.author: user298323

reviews.title: bags lost on honeymoon
reviews.text: Terrible airline that i would never recommend! Flight was delayed and gate was changed (which i only knew because i checked, gate agents never made an announcement), then boarding was a mess. Flight was fine—no wifi or food or beverages but on such a short flight that’s ok. My suitcase never arrived and I’ve been contacting the airline for a week. I was told after 21 days it’s declared lost, but that i may not even hear back with an update on if my bag was found or if i will be compensated for 4-6 weeks. This is OUTRAGEOUS!!! Never ever ever flying this airline again and don’t recommend you do either. Not worth the low cost even on a short trip. And if you must fly this airline, do NOT check a bag!

reviews.title: No honesty regarding late flights
reviews.text: I've taken another delayed flight with Volotea, and they've been unable to warn us about the plane being 1h15 late. This is publicly available information so it is obvious that a plane landing at 6:30pm (which is information that is known for at least 2 hours before landing) cannot lay off at 6pm, add to that the time to empty and fill the plane and you've got a noticeable delay that is easy to plan. It would be a minimum to respect your users and warn them about such delays, so we can at least warn people that are picking us up or enjoy more time outside of the checked zone instead of standing like idiots for an hour.
